name: m4-direct-compile
description: Time benefit of direct emission on a full compile, which the m5 campaigns left unresolved (about 1% estimated from profiles; a review expects 0.5 to 0.8%). One fork per variant per round, with an A/A beside it. Instructions from xctrace as well as time. Release optimizer settings; patched JDK 26.

variantDescriptions.baseaa: The same build as `base`, the A/A control
variantDescriptions.direct: [retronym/scala#203](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/203) at `27b2342cf9`: classes written directly from codegen, with the fixes for the two load-time failures
